title: The 1848 Constitutional Turning Point and Parliamentary Responsibility

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: The April Laws, sanctioned on 11 April 1848, began to turn Hungary from a feudal estates monarchy into a civic constitutional monarchy; the right to vote remained limited.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: The cornerstone was Act III of 1848, creating a government responsible to parliament (*felelős minisztérium*), replacing rule by royal decree with a government that needed the countersignature of a minister.
